name: Journey Orchestration & Next-Best-Action
description: Real-time cross-channel state engine that tracks customer lifecycle context, evaluates business and propensity rules to arbitrate the Next-Best-Action (NBA), triggers proactive nudges, and suppresses redundant outreach.
roleInCenter: Cross-channel brain: maintains persistent journey state across time and channels so every inbound or proactive touchpoint advances the customer's goal without repetition.

glossary.definition: Persistent graph tracking a customer's current lifecycle stage, open issues, prior channel touches, and pending commitments across sessions
Streaming business or telemetry event such as a failed payment, shipment delay, or repeated app error that initiates or transitions a journey state
Decisioning matrix that ranks competing retention, service recovery, protocol, and sales actions by customer value, urgency, and eligibility
Governance control that halts marketing or automated outbound campaigns when an active service escalation, dispute, or recent contact exists
Timely push notification, SMS, or in-app card sent ahead of a predicted inbound call to resolve an issue or confirm status effortlessly
Rolling window ceiling limiting total proactive notifications and outbound touches across all channels per customer
Shared context payload linking a digital web failure or mobile app flow directly to an inbound voice or chat session within the same journey
Automated orchestration step that follows up on high-value cart, application, or queue abandons via preferred asynchronous channel

facets.name: Journey Event Triggers & State Management
facets.description: Signals and state transitions that drive real-time journey progression

children.name: Service or Fulfillment Exception
children.description: Order delay, outage impact, or appointment reschedule event

children.name: Billing Shock or Declined Payment
children.description: Unusual bill spike or renewal failure likely to drive an inbound contact

children.name: Digital Friction & Rage-Click Signal
children.description: Repeated form errors, failed login attempts, or help-page looping in web or app

children.name: Onboarding & First-Value Stage
children.description: Guided setup and early adoption milestones

children.name: Active Case & Recovery Stage
children.description: Open support ticket or SLA breach recovery state

children.name: Churn Risk & Retention Stage
children.description: Contract maturity or downgrade signal requiring retention arbitration

facets.name: Next-Best-Action Arbitration & Policy
facets.description: Scoring and prioritization logic selecting the single best action for a customer moment

children.name: Regulatory, Fraud & Safety Override
children.description: Mandatory security verification or regulatory disclosure preempts all other actions

children.name: Urgent Service Recovery & SLA Save
children.description: Proactive apology, fee credit, or priority routing when service failure occurred

children.name: Churn Prevention & Retention Offer
children.description: Targeted loyalty intervention for high-LTV customers exhibiting churn signals

children.name: Contextual Cross-Sell & Onboarding
children.description: Eligible plan optimization or feature adoption offer only when sentiment is positive

children.name: Live Agent Co-Pilot NBA Card
children.description: Surfaces arbitrated action directly inside an active voice or chat handling session

children.name: Proactive SMS or In-App Notification
children.description: Low-friction digital nudge honoring customer channel preference and quiet hours

facets.name: Channel Suppression & Contact Governance
facets.description: Guardrails preventing conflicting messages, over-contacting, and tone-deaf outreach

children.name: Open Escalation Promotional Mute
children.description: Suppresses all sales and marketing outreach while an unresolved complaint or high-priority ticket is open

children.name: Post-Contact Outbound Cooldown
children.description: Cancels scheduled outbound reminders if the customer resolved the issue inbound minutes earlier

children.name: Multi-Channel Alert Deduplication
children.description: Ensures a single disruption event sends one preferred notification rather than simultaneous email, SMS, and voice blasts

metrics.name: Proactive Nudge Inbound Deflection Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of customers receiving a proactive status or resolution nudge who do not initiate a predicted inbound contact within 48 hours

metrics.name: NBA-Attributed Contact Value
metrics.definition: Average retained or incremental customer value realized per interaction where the arbitrated Next-Best-Action was executed

metrics.name: End-to-End Journey Resolution Rate
metrics.definition: Share of multi-step customer journeys resolved on the first assisted or automated touch without channel-hopping repeats

metrics.name: High-Priority Journey Escalation Intercepts
metrics.definition: Count of critical at-risk customer journeys requiring high-priority queue intervention

metrics.name: Cross-Channel Journey CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction score on interactions where prior digital or proactive journey state was preserved into handling

failureModes.name: Tone-Deaf Upsell During Service Failure
failureModes.signal: Angry customers receive promotional NBA offers during outage or billing-dispute calls; CSAT drops and complaints spike
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce real-time sentiment and open-incident suppression gates that zero commercial NBA weights when frustration or active tickets exist

failureModes.name: Delayed Event Nudge After Resolution
failureModes.signal: Customers receive proactive 'issue detected' SMS hours after already calling in and resolving the problem, triggering confused repeat calls
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce sub-second CRM and ACD disposition state checks immediately prior to message dispatch

failureModes.name: Web-to-Voice Journey Amnesia
failureModes.signal: Customer clicks 'Call Support' inside an authenticated app error flow but lands in generic IVR root menu with no context
failureModes.mitigation: Pass short-lived journey continuity tokens bindable by ANI or one-time session code to fast-track IVR and ACD routing

failureModes.name: Siloed Campaign Fatigue Cap Bypass
failureModes.signal: Opt-out rates and spam complaints climb because billing, collections, and marketing triggers fire independently on the same day
failureModes.mitigation: Centralize all outbound and proactive triggers through a unified journey suppression ledger with hard daily and weekly caps

exchanges: Customer tier, lifetime value, consent flags, and open case states read for NBA arbitration
Journey state transitions and NBA acceptance outcomes persisted to customer record
Journey continuity context, predicted intent, and dynamic priority boosts passed at call arrival
Queue wait telemetry read to decide between live routing and proactive digital deflection
Proactive nudge dispatches and abandon-recovery triggers sent for campaign execution
Real-time channel suppression and fatigue-cap blocks enforced before dialing or messaging
Visual customer journey timeline and arbitrated Next-Best-Action card pushed to agent desktop
Agent action disposition and offer response captured in real time
